narration: Your income is too high for a Roth IRA — or so you've been told. The IRS built a legal backdoor right into the tax code, and 88% of high earners have never heard of it.
visual: A large ROTH IRA door with an arch top and a red NO ENTRY sign + padlock. A smaller glowing blue BACKDOOR door appears beside it, swinging open with a glow effect. Arrow points to the backdoor.

narration: Here's the problem. Earn over $161,000 single or $240,000 married and the IRS completely blocks you from a Roth — the account where your money grows tax-free forever. And next scene shows your move.
visual: Vertical income thermometer with fill rising. Dashed threshold lines at $161K (single) and $240K (married). When bar crosses $161K, a padlock snaps onto a piggy bank labeled ROTH IRA on the right side.

narration: Number one: open a traditional IRA and drop in up to $7,000. Because this contribution is non-deductible, there's literally no income limit — anybody can do this step, no matter what you earn.
visual: Two side-by-side buckets labeled TRADITIONAL IRA and ROTH IRA. Coins animate falling into the Traditional bucket. A $7,000 counter ticks up. A green checkmark badge: NO INCOME LIMIT.

narration: Number two: within a day or two, you convert that traditional IRA straight into a Roth. The IRS specifically allows this at any income level — no limits, no tricks, completely legal.
visual: Two labeled account boxes connected by an animated arrow. Blue coins travel from TRADITIONAL IRA to ROTH IRA along the arrow. ROTH CONVERSION label appears. Green LEGAL AT ANY INCOME badge.

narration: Do this every year and that $7,000 compounds inside a Roth — completely tax-free. Over 20 years at 7%, you've built $287,000. At withdrawal, you owe zero. That's $89,000 saved in taxes.
visual: Two growing bar charts: BACKDOOR ROTH (blue) rising to $287K and TAXABLE (gray) stopping at $198K. Dollar counters animate. A '$89K SAVED' gold badge pulses between the bars.

narration: The backdoor Roth is one of the cleanest loopholes in the tax code. If your financial advisor hasn't mentioned it, ask them why. Follow for more moves the wealthy quietly use.
visual: Person silhouette in center with a glowing blue checkmark halo overhead. Text: BACKDOOR ROTH glows in blue above. ASK YOUR ADVISOR TODAY below. A bouncing FOLLOW arrow at the screen bottom.
